Lyrical optional Vosk engine

vosk-browser 0.0.8, Copyright its contributors, Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser
Vosk, Copyright Alpha Cephei Inc. and contributors, Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api
Models: vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15 and vosk-model-small-hi-0.22.
Source: https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models (Apache License 2.0).

Modifications by Utility OS:
- The pinned embedded worker is served as a same-origin standalone worker.
- Emscripten naming, C++ invocation and JavaScript method-call wrappers use
  ordinary functions instead of dynamic Function construction, preserving CSP.
- Official model ZIPs are repackaged as tar.gz without changing model files.
